request.systemPrompt: You map reports of public institutions or media in Europe being flooded with mass submissions. List one event per article and give the country where it happened. Use only what the article says; never guess. Quotes are copied verbatim in the original language, never translated. Skip opinion pieces, scams aimed at individuals and single complaints.

url.description: URL of the article that reports this event; must be one of the search results

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD when it happened, else the article's publication date

type.description: T3 mass complaints/requests/petitions to public bodies; T5 mass threat or hoax emails to schools, courts, hospitals; T6 flooding of newsrooms, fact-checkers or media regulators; AI rise in complaints written with AI by ordinary people; none otherwise

target.description: bodies targeted and the size as written, a few words in English

voice.description: who says it is hostile or coordinated: official = named government body, minister, police or security service

attribution.description: named = a named state or group is blamed; suspected = suspicion or hypothesis

quote.description: ONE sentence copied EXACTLY from the article, original language, under 220 characters
